+        def iter_choices(self):
+            yield ("a", "<A>", True)
+            yield ("b", "B", False, {"title": "<tip>", "disabled": True})
+
+        def has_groups(self):
+            return grouped
+
+        def iter_groups(self):
+            yield ("<group>", self.iter_choices())
+            yield ("Empty", iter(()))

+        item = CustomSelect(choices=[], validate_choice=False)
+
+    form = F(item="a")
+    html = str(form.item())
+    assert '<option selected value="a"><A></option>' in html
+    assert '<option disabled title="<tip>" value="b">B</option>' in html
+    if grouped:
+        assert '<optgroup label="<group>">' in html
